cutoff: after final precommit research-consistency checking and before packaging or publication
measurement_notes: Command wall times are enclosing recorded processes; child CPU is not added to wall time.
Point samples do not establish peak memory, unseen storage peaks, energy, or network overhead.
Reading, reasoning, writing, active human effort, charges, and complete publication work are not measured.
Inherited experiment times are not charged again and were not used as current execution time.
Final packaging, Git integration, push, and readback are retained in the private owner tail rather than predicted here.
